Pavel Dvorak  
Prague, Czech Republic | +420 777 123 456 | pavel.dvorak@email.com | linkedin.com/in/pavel-dvorak  
A detail-oriented professional with a focus on streamlining workflows and enhancing system reliability within a fintech environment. Collaborative approach to problem-solving, with a commitment to delivering scalable solutions that align with business objectives.  

During the past year, I transitioned from an intern role to a junior DevOps engineer and subsequently to a platform engineer position at FinTech Solutions Inc., a mid-sized fintech startup. In my initial role as a DevOps intern, I supported the deployment of internal tools by refining CI/CD pipelines, which reduced manual intervention for repetitive tasks. This experience laid the foundation for my later work as a junior DevOps engineer, where I collaborated with cross-functional teams to automate infrastructure setup and improve incident response times. As a platform engineer, I expanded my responsibilities to include designing scalable solutions for internal tools, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems while maintaining high availability standards.  

One key project involved the development of an automated deployment framework for a trading platform, which streamlined the release process and minimized downtime during updates. This required close coordination with developers and operations teams to align technical requirements with business needs. Another project focused on migrating a legacy payment processing system to a more modular architecture, enabling faster iterations and improved scalability. The solution incorporated tools like Git for version control and Jira for task management, ensuring transparency and accountability across teams. Recently, I led the implementation of a monitoring system using Grafana and Prometheus to track system performance, which allowed stakeholders to proactively address potential bottlenecks.  

Graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the Technical University of Prague in 2023, with a focus on software development and system design. My academic background provided a strong foundation in programming principles and problem-solving techniques, which I have applied to real-world challenges in the fintech sector.  

Technical proficiency includes collaboration tools like Git, Jira, and Confluence, as well as monitoring solutions such as Grafana and Prometheus. Experience with scripting to automate repetitive tasks and optimize workflows. Familiarity with cloud-native concepts and tools tailored to support agile development practices.  

No certifications listed.  

Fluent in English and Czech.
